headline: TSMC rebound cushions TAIEX as losses deepen - Taipei Times
summary: Taiwan shares extended losses on fears of further volatility after a strong recent showing. TSMC staged a technical rebound that limited the broader market decline.
why: The TAIEX is Taiwan's benchmark index, heavily weighted toward semiconductors. TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker and a bellwether for the global chip supply chain.

impacts.name: TAIEX
impacts.why: The benchmark Taiwan index fell as shares extended losses.
